source.description:
## CLARIFIED REQUIREMENT

The 'background' requested was the BADGE CHIP behind the tool name as it was before ANY modifications: dark text (\x1b[38;2;3;8;12m) on the static per-kind colored background (serena cyan, gitnexus purple, ...). No phase color changing, plain and static. New layout only: no [] brackets, marker + chip + bold action.

## CHANGES

- Restore externalToolBadgeColor (chip: dark text on kind bg).
- Header: '› <chip>Provider</chip> <action>' — chip static in every state, no brackets.
- Remove phase machinery: ExternalToolState, externalToolStateBgToken, padToRenderWidth, theme import/themeLike/bgFn in patch; drop state+themeLike params from renderExternalToolLines/BackgroundLines. Keep the try/catch guard and version bump.
- Tests: chip format assertions without brackets, static across lifecycle states.

## VALIDATION

- xtrm-ui tests green; tsc no new errors.
source.notes: Superseded direction: operator now wants NO chip — provider as plain fg text in gitnexus purple, uniform for all kinds (xtrm-mcayj).
source.title: xtrm-ui: external tool badge — restore exact pre-change chip (dark text on static kind bg), new layout only
